description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldImage class, a subclass of SugarWidgetFieldVarchar, responsible for rendering an image link in list views within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes a method to generate a lightbox link for viewing images.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldImage
classes.description: A widget class for rendering image links in list views, extending SugarWidgetFieldVarchar.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns HTML anchor tag with a JavaScript call to open the image in a lightbox, using a value retrieved from the list data.
